evidence.quote: TOOL RESULT (ERROR): Error: non-pending order cannot be modified

observed_facts: The user requested to change both the item color and the delivery address of a pending order.
The agent modified the pending order items at step 39, which locked the order status to 'pending (item modified)'.
At step 43, the agent attempted to modify the pending order address, but the tool failed because the order was no longer pending.
inference: Modifying the items before updating the address caused the order status to change permanently, preventing the subsequent address modification due to policy constraints.
The agent failed to plan the sequence correctly by modifying items first instead of updating the address or combining the modifications appropriately.
needs_verification: Whether the retail store policy permits modifying both items and address in a different order or if the system locks the order upon any modification.
parsed.summary: The agent modified the pending order items before updating the shipping address, locking the order status and causing the subsequent address modification to fail.
